the intrinsic gluon contribution to g{sub 2}(x) is dominated by the light quark sea and the extrinsic gluon contributions are dominated by the heavy quark sea.

the heavy quark contributions to the gluon distribution can be neglected for all but the very highest values of Q{sup 2}.
